facts.fact: The National Registration Bureau said Malawi will implement a nationwide digital ID by 2026 after a successful pilot, enabling identity verification mainly through mobile phones for services including healthcare providers and financial institutions.
facts.system: Malawi digital ID (NRB) mobile identity verification

systems.system: Malawi digital ID (NRB) mobile identity verification

note: as_of is the document's published date; the pilot and announcement are not dated more closely.
